behaviors.description: Embed runtime repository descriptor URL in application bundle.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A repo; no installed runtime or configured remotes.
behaviors.expected: Bundle installation fetches descriptor and installs exact runtime dependency.

behaviors.description: Mark exported app as belonging to selected subset.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent finalized app tree without subset marker.
behaviors.expected: Public commit xa.subsets equals requested singleton list.

behaviors.preconditions: Independent runtime tree and supported alternate architecture.
behaviors.expected: Alternate ref exists and native ref is absent.

behaviors.description: Sign exported app and attach rebase destination while updating AppStream.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent finalized app tree and disposable signing material.
behaviors.expected: Public-key signature verifies, EOL rebase equals requested ref and AppStream branch exists.

behaviors.preconditions: Reference finalized app tree with extra build-only data.
behaviors.expected: Public OSTree checkout contains identical executable, export and metadata, excluding var and build-only data.

behaviors.preconditions: Independent runtime tree with a usr marker.
behaviors.expected: Runtime ref checkout has marker under files.

behaviors.description: Apply export filters, commit message/date, EOL and collection ID.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent finalized app tree with matching include/exclude candidates.
behaviors.expected: Exact selected files, commit fields and repo collection ID; summary absent.

behaviors.description: Select alternate payload and metadata files.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent finalized tree with distinct alternate inputs.
behaviors.expected: Only alternate payload and alternate command metadata exported.

behaviors.description: Sign repository summary and advertise imported public key.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned A repository and disposable signing material.
behaviors.expected: Independent OSTree remote with mandatory summary verification reads refs; advertised public key bytes equal input.

behaviors.preconditions: Independent repo containing both architectures and disposable signing key.
behaviors.expected: Alternate commit verifies with public key.

behaviors.description: Sign an existing app commit using disposable GPG material.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned A distribution repo and disposable key.
behaviors.expected: Commit unchanged and independent GPG verification succeeds.

behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned runtime and disposable GPG home.
behaviors.expected: Runtime commit unchanged and independent GPG verification succeeds.
